text: dsh-plugin-mirobody 是面向 DSH Web 的 Mirobody 健康数据插件：它注册工具、斜杠命令、提示规则、受连接检查保护的 HTTP 路由，以及会话中的 Mirobody 面板。离线引擎可把指标名解析为 LOINC、按数值和单位解析读数，并转换或规范化 UCUM 单位；记录工具可只读查询健康指标、用药计划与记录、基因型和药物基因组学信息。还提供状态查看、快捷解析、五类技能和健康安全提示。适合需要在 DSH 中整理健康测量并查看个人 Mirobody 记录的用户；术语功能走本机 Python 引擎，读取记录前需配置 Mirobody MCP 地址及相应授权。

dsh-plugin-mirobody adds health tools and a panel to DSH web. Its local engine resolves LOINC names and standardizes UCUM units. Read-only tools query health, medication, genotype, and pharmacogenomics records from a configured Mirobody server. Record access requires account authorization.
想把化验指标名称对应到标准 LOINC 编码。
有没有能把 mmol/L 这类单位统一成 UCUM 的工具？
我想在 DSH 里查看自己的健康指标和历史趋势。
能不能从个人健康服务器查用药计划和服药记录？
怎么按基因或 rsID 查看我上传的基因型数据？
希望核对某种药物对应的药物基因组学指南信息。
I need to map lab names and measured values to LOINC codes.
Can I normalize or convert health measurement units in DSH?
dsh-plugin-mirobody 的功能「指标与读数解析」：把指标名称或名称、数值和单位交给离线引擎解析为 LOINC；批量输入返回匹配结果，无法确认时保持未解析。 由 DSH 工具调用，输入参数并返回结构化结果。
dsh-plugin-mirobody 的功能「单位规范与转换」：将自由格式单位规范为 UCUM，或在给定源单位、目标单位及数值后执行转换；不兼容时返回空转换结果。 由 DSH 工具调用，输入参数并返回结构化结果。
dsh-plugin-mirobody 的功能「健康及用药记录」：通过配置的 MCP 服务器只读查询健康指标、时间序列视图，以及用药计划、剂量日志和疗程历史。 由 DSH 工具调用，输入参数并返回结构化结果。
dsh-plugin-mirobody 的功能「基因和药物基因组学」：按 rsID、基因或基因组区段读取已上传的基因型，也可查找 CPIC A/B 药物基因对及覆盖位点。 由 DSH 工具调用，输入参数并返回结构化结果。
dsh-plugin-mirobody 的记录查询会把查询参数发送到配置的 Mirobody MCP 地址，并读取该授权账户的数据；空缺记录不代表正常，插件的记录工具为只读。
dsh-plugin-mirobody 的记录查询需要在本地 DSH 配置 mcpUrl，并以 mcpToken 或含授权信息的个人 MCP 链接访问；术语解析本身使用本机引擎。

dsh-plugin-mirobody README · dsh-plugin-mirobody：**English** · **[中文](README.zh.md)**

DeepSeek Harness plugin for [Mirobody](https://github.com/thetahealth/mirobody): one LOINC code for a lab name, one UCUM unit, and the same read-only record tools Mirobody serves at `/mcp`.

The Python engine stays the resolver. This package is the harness: nine tools, five skills, a Mirobody tab, and slash commands. It does not reimplement the LOINC bundle, Postgres, wearable OAuth, or file ingestion.

dsh-plugin-mirobody README · Install：Requires Node 22.19+, pnpm (`dsh plugin` installs through it), and a Python 3.12+ interpreter with `mirobody` installed. The record tools follow Mirobody 1.5.2 and later (tested against 1.5.9); a 1.5.1 server rejects their `view` parameter.

dsh-plugin-mirobody README · Install：**With [dsh-plugin-longpi](https://github.com/zwbao/dsh-plugin-longpi) you do not install this separately.** LongPi declares this plugin as a dependency, so `dsh plugin add` puts it in the profile and LongPi mounts it with the settings in LongPi's own row. Adding it a second time registers the same tools twice.

On its own:

```bash
dsh-plugin-mirobody README · 1. The Python engine (offline terminology)：python3.12 -m venv ~/.venvs/mirobody && ~/.venvs/mirobody/bin/pip install mirobody

dsh-plugin-mirobody README · 2. Into the DSH web profile (created on first use)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:zwbao/dsh-plugin-mirobody
```

Then override the row in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (replace the file's `[]` with the block below). A patch replaces the row's whole `config`, so restate every key:
section: 2. Into the DSH web profile (created on first use)

text:
dsh-plugin-mirobody README · 2. Into the DSH web profile (created on first use)：```yaml
- id: dsh-plugin-mirobody
  config:
    pythonBin: /Users/you/.venvs/mirobody/bin/python   # your absolute path
    mirobodyHome: ''
    mcpUrl: http://127.0.0.1:18060/mcp/<personal-secret>  # Mirobody Settings → MCP
    mcpToken: ''
    timeoutMs: 30000
```
section: 2. Into the DSH web profile (created on first use)

text: dsh-plugin-mirobody README · 2. Into the DSH web profile (created on first use)：`dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows the row in effect; then restart `dsh web`. From a checkout: `git clone https://github.com/zwbao/dsh-plugin-mirobody && cd dsh-plugin-mirobody && npm install && npm test && dsh plugin --profile web add link:$PWD`. `npm test` also compares the record tools with the installed Mirobody's own schemas when `MIROBODY_PYTHON` (or `./.venv`) can import them, which needs `python-dotenv ruamel.yaml cryptography` beside `mirobody`. Against a running server: `MIROBODY_E2E_MCP_URL=<personal MCP link> npm run e2e` (the account needs readings, a medication plan and a genotype upload, or Mirobody hides those tools).
section: 2. Into the DSH web profile (created on first use)

text:
dsh-plugin-mirobody README · 2. Into the DSH web profile (created on first use)：| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `pythonBin` | Interpreter that can `import mirobody`. Empty tries `python3.14`, `python3.13`, `python3.12`, then `python3`. |
| `mirobodyHome` | Optional source checkout added to `sys.path`. A checkout still needs `git lfs pull` for the LOINC bundle. |
| `mcpUrl` | Record server: the personal URL from Mirobody Settings → MCP (`…/mcp/<secret>`, valid 10 days by default since Mirobody 1.5.3, `MCP_URL_TTL_DAYS`), or `http://127.0.0.1:18060/mcp` with `mcpToken`. |
| `mcpToken` | Account JWT when the URL does not carry one (the `access_token` from `POST /password/login`, valid 30 days by default). Leave empty for terminology-only use. |
| `timeoutMs` | Bridge and MCP budget. Default `30000`. First resolve loads the bundle and can be slower. |
section: 2. Into the DSH web profile (created on first use)

text: dsh-plugin-mirobody README · 2. Into the DSH web profile (created on first use)：The Python bridge starts with a minimal environment, never the harness's own: `PATH`, `HOME`, `LANG`, `LC_ALL`, `TMPDIR`, `MIROBODY_HOME` (from `mirobodyHome`), `PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1` and `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`. So `pythonBin` must import `mirobody` from its own site-packages (the venv above); a `pip install --user` copy and `PYTHONPATH` are not seen. Use `mirobodyHome` for a source checkout.
section: 2. Into the DSH web profile (created on first use)

text:
dsh-plugin-mirobody README · Tools：| Tool | Where it runs | What it returns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `resolve_indicator` | local engine | LOINC for each printed name. Unresolved is empty, not a guess. |
| `resolve_reading` | local engine | LOINC for a name plus value and unit. The unit selects the code. |
| `convert_unit` | local engine | A converted number, or `null` when the units are not interconvertible. |
| `normalize_unit` | local engine | UCUM form and property family. |
| `query_health_indicators` | Mirobody `/mcp` | Catalogue, then one `view`: raw rows, minute…month points, stats, trend, or latest. |
| `query_medications` | Mirobody `/mcp` | Plan, dose log, or course history. Read-only. |
| `query_genetic_data` | Mirobody `/mcp` | Genotype calls by rsID, gene, or region; a summary with none. A missing locus was not typed. |
| `query_pharmacogenomics` | Mirobody `/mcp` | CPIC A/B drug–gene pairs and which defining sites the upload covers. Not a phenotype, not dosing. |
| `mirobody_status` | local | Whether the engine imports, and whether `mcpUrl` is set. No chart data, no token. |

dsh-plugin-mirobody README · Tools：Record tools read only the account the token or personal link belongs to; there is no parameter for another person. Mirobody checks the arguments itself and its refusal names each parameter, so the plugin does not keep a copy of the server's grammar.

dsh-plugin-mirobody README · Commands and HTTP：- `/mirobody` — engine version and whether MCP is configured
- `/mirobody-resolve 血红蛋白 血脂` — offline resolve
- `/mirobody-version`
- `GET /api/mirobody/status`
- `GET /api/mirobody/resolve?q=血红蛋白&q=血脂`
- `GET /api/mirobody/version`

Each route runs DeepSeek Harness's own connection check first (Host/Origin and the session cookie): 401 or 403 otherwise, 503 when the connection service is missing. A write must be `application/json` (415 otherwise).
dsh-plugin-mirobody README · Commands and HTTP：The web tab is **Mirobody**. It forwards the DSH `token` query parameter the same way the page was opened and sends the session cookie.

dsh-plugin-mirobody README · Boundaries：Not a medical device. No diagnosis, no dose change. When a message describes an emergency happening now, or real self-harm wording, the plugin appends a note after it so the reply begins with “call 120” (988 in the US) and gives no treatment steps; a request to start, stop or change a medicine gets a note to leave it to the prescribing doctor. The person's words are never replaced. A negated symptom, a family member's history, a risk question or a past event does not trigger it. See [docs/intended-use.md](docs/intended-use.md).

dsh-plugin-mirobody README · Boundaries：`血红蛋白` resolves to `718-7`. `血脂` resolves to nothing, because it names a panel. Total cholesterol `5.0 mmol/L` resolves to `14647-2`.
